title: Script Hub (UPDATED)
script:
local DiscordLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/UI-Libs/main/discord%20lib.txt")()

function giveptreward(ptreward)
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Honeypot.Internal.RemoteStorage:FindFirstChild("ClaimPlaytimeReward - RemoteEvent"):FireServer(ptreward)   
end

local win = DiscordLib:Window("block eaters")

local serv = win:Server("Main", "")

local btns = serv:Channel("Givers")

local spinrewardtogive = nil

btns:Dropdown("Give Spins",{"1","2","3"}, function(bool)
    if bool == "1" then
        spinrewardtogive = 3
    elseif bool == "2" then
        spinrewardtogive = 6
    elseif bool == "3" then
        spinrewardtogive = 9
    end
end)

btns:Button("Give", function()
    if spinrewardtogive then
        giveptreward(spinrewardtogive)
    end
end)

btns:Seperator()

local rewardtogive = nil

btns:Dropdown("Give Blocks",{"1k","3k","5k","10k","25k","50k","100k","250k","1m","10m","100m","1b", "10b"}, function(bool)
    if bool == "1k" then
        rewardtogive = 1
    elseif bool == "3k" then
        rewardtogive = 2
    elseif bool == "5k" then
        rewardtogive = 4
    elseif bool == "10k" then
        rewardtogive = 5
    elseif bool == "25k" then
        rewardtogive = 7
    elseif bool == "50k" then
        rewardtogive = 8
    elseif bool == "100k" then
        rewardtogive = 10
    elseif bool == "250k" then
        rewardtogive = 11
    elseif bool == "1m" then
        rewardtogive = 12
    elseif bool == "10m" then
        rewardtogive = 13
    elseif bool == "100m" then
        rewardtogive = 14
    elseif bool == "1b" then
        rewardtogive = 15
    elseif bool == "10b" then
        rewardtogive = 16
    end
end)

btns:Button("Give", function()
    if rewardtogive then
        if rewardtogive == 13 then
            for i=1,10 do
                giveptreward(12)
            end
        elseif rewardtogive == 14 then
            for i=1,100 do
                giveptreward(12)
            end
        elseif rewardtogive == 15 then
            for i=1,1000 do
                giveptreward(12)
            end
        elseif rewardtogive == 16 then
            for i=1,10000 do
                giveptreward(12)
            end
        else
            giveptreward(rewardtogive)
        end
    end
end)


local tgls = serv:Channel("Toggles")

local blockfarm = false

tgls:Toggle("Auto-Farm Blocks",false, function(bool)
    blockfarm = bool
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait() do
        if blockfarm then
                giveptreward(12)
        end
    end
end)


local spinsfarm = false

tgls:Toggle("Auto-Farm Spins",false, function(bool)
    spinsfarm = bool
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait() do
        if spinsfarm then
            for i=1,100 do
                giveptreward(9)
            end
            task.wait(.1)
        end
    end
end)

serv:Channel("by ramann")
features:
Auto farm spins, give spins, auto farm blocks, give blocks (up to 10b)


DISCLAIMER: the auto farm delay to turn off is not my fault, the game plays an animation before it actually stops
